answer: Cross-attestation quorum: each agent must get k distinct attestations from agents whose provenance graph is unlinked to it, verified by a basalt-hard scoring rule that flags shared signup fingerprints. Because each attestation costs the voucher a staked bond, an attacker at the sybil nadir must pay k times per fake identity while risking slashed bonds on every marble of collusion detectable across the quorum, so scaling a sock-puppet army grows superlinearly in cost.
